name: Embed the game's data in the executable
body: `mist run package` leaves loose files beside the binary (D-217). Pack the game folder (scripts, UI, worlds, textures, models, sounds, music) and the compiled shaders into the executable so a packaged build is one file. Calamus and graph JSON stay out. Provisional design: an archive appended to the binary, found at start, unpacked to a per-user cache keyed by content hash, then run as an ordinary game folder; a virtual file system that serves reads from memory is the follow-up.
